name: KCl
notes: KCl  B2 (EOS from Campbell and Heinz, 1991)

eos_records.label: B2 (EOS from Campbell and Heinz, 1991)
eos_records.reference: Campbell and Heinz, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 52, 495-499 (1991), doi:10.1016/0022-3697(91)90181-X
eos_records.notes: Campbell and Heinz report V0(B2)/V0(B1) = 0.8483 +/- 0.0057 and K0 = 28.7 +/- 0.6 GPa, with K0' constrained to 4.0. This is stored as BM2; V0 and its propagated uncertainty use the ambient B1 reference volume.

eos_records.label: Walker et al. (2002), B2 thermal Birch
eos_records.reference: Walker et al., American Mineralogist 87, 805-812 (2002), doi:10.2138/am-2002-0701
eos_records.notes: Walker et al. B2 KCl parameters (Z=1). The authors explicitly state that tradeoffs between V0, K0, and K0' make errors on the individual parameters non-meaningful, so none are quoted.
